run.name: CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (CCC)
run.summary: CCC has a sound standalone credit profile, with 2.64x gross leverage, USD 451.9 million of liquidity and strong cash conversion, but the pending take-private makes its post-closing credit unassessable. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 1,281,216 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 484,946 (C1, C3); net of cash 202,926; excludes the 27,562 non-recourse subsidiary note; on Adjusted EBITDA less share-based pay and related payroll tax the ratios are 3.58x and 3.01x (C5); not a covenant ratio and no pro forma for the merger

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 484,946 over LTM cash interest 72,448 (C1, C4); on Adjusted EBITDA less share-based pay and related payroll tax the ratio is 4.95x (C5); swap settlements paid of 1.5 million for 9M 2026 are in other income and not in cash interest

cash.basis: Cash. Cash at 2026-09-30 (10-Q Q3 page:4); revolver undrawn, 250.0 commitment less 1.0 of standby letters of credit; total of cash and availability 451.926 (C7); the revolver matures 2029-09-23 with a springing maturity of 2028-06-22 if more than 234.0 of term loan remains; borrowing is subject to the merger agreement's debt incurrence limits (10-Q Q3 pages:45, 52)

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The merger agreement, the buyer's financing and the credit agreement are not in the pack, so the treatment of the term loan at closing is unknown.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA adds back share-based pay, covenant definitions are not in the pack, and the pending take-private leaves the post-deal debt unknown.
